name: VideoEval-Pro
intro: VideoEval-Pro 是 Seed2.0 报告中使用的视频理解 benchmark，用于更专业的视频理解和推理评估。
build_method: 长视频选择题偏差审计, 全视频依赖开放短答题, 人工核验
metric: Open-ended Short-answer Accuracy by scope and task
task_type: 视频问答, 视频推理
build_method_en: Long-video MCQ bias audit, full-video-dependent open short answers, human verification
intro_en: VideoEval-Pro is a video understanding benchmark used by the Seed2.0 report for more professional video understanding and reasoning evaluation.
metric_en: Open-ended Short-answer Accuracy by scope and task
drawio_review_note: Aligned with VideoEval-Pro arXiv:2505.14640, benchmark construction and evaluation sections; official TIGER-Lab release. VideoEval-Pro audits long-video MCQs for guessing and video-free shortcuts, then builds open-ended short-answer questions that require segment-level or full-video perception and reasoning. Models answer without options; judged correctness is reported by scope and task, with frame-scaling tests checking whether more video evidence helps.
